reader.requirement: At --std 85, the redefining entry's storage starts at the first character position of data-name-2 and extends over as many character positions as the subject (data-name-1 or FILLER) describes, including a level-01 non-EXTERNAL subject LARGER than data-name-2 (SR6 exempts it), at every level (01/77 and subordinate, inside an OCCURS per occurrence) and in every section the clause is allowed (working-storage, file record subordinates).
reader.edition-search: grep of Edition./CobolVersion/DialectLevel/Has( over ResolveRedefinesPass.cs, ClassifyRedefinesClassesPass.cs, RedefinesModel.cs, PlaceBuilder.cs, ReferenceResolver.cs and CodeGen/DataDivision/PhysicalModel.cs, RecordStructEmitter.cs, CodeGen/Roslyn/PlaceRenderer.cs: only Edition.At / Edition.Error / Edition.Removed (the strict-or-permissive severity seam, not an edition test) appear; ReferenceResolver's one Edition.Has(2002) is the EXCEPTION-OBJECT register, off this path. The storage layout and the place builder are one arm at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises subordinate same-size redefinitions inside OCCURS and an ODO table; not exercised: a level-01 redefinition larger than data-name-2, mixed-usage group overlays (COMP-3, COMP, signed DISPLAY), a file record subordinate, and the larger-than-target refusal at level 02

reader.notes: The storage class (Tier A alias or Tier B one string backing of class-max width) starts every view at data-name-2 and sizes the backing to the largest member, so a larger level-01 redefinition owns its full width without touching the next record. Lead for SR5 (not this rule): at 85 `10 VB REDEFINES VA` with VA under an ODO table compiles (odo2.cob, and the witness's L9); §1985:III.2 makes an item subordinate to an ODO entry a variable occurrence data item, so §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR5's 'Neither the original definition nor the redefinition can include a variable occurrence data item' may refuse it; the compiler reads 'include' as an ODO table inside the area (COBOL0855).
